title: Modal 把 GPU 冷啟動壓到 50 秒——LP、FUSE、C/R、CUDA-checkpoint
summary: Modal 用 LP / FUSE / C/R / CUDA-checkpoint 四層快照把 GPU 冷啟動從 ~2,000 秒壓到 ~50 秒。
widget_questions: Which of the four cold-start layers owns each responsibility, and what does each layer explicitly NOT know about the others?
How sensitive is end-to-end cold start to disabling each individual layer — does removing one layer slow the system slightly, or does it restore that layer's full baseline overhead?
What does the absolute and relative speedup look like across vLLM, SGLang, and Qwen 3 0.6B when snapshot is OFF vs ON, and which framework benefits most?
